title: First EDIP Ukraine support call draws 58 defence proposals
dek: The €184.5 million USI-IRA call on missiles, ammunition and bombs attracted bids from 11 Member States and Ukraine; results are due in March 2027.
key_facts: Up to €30 million, 100% of eligible costs
body: The first call under the Ukraine Support Instrument of the European Defence Industry Programme (EDIP) closed on 10 November 2026 at 17:00 with 58 proposals, the Commission's Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space reported. Applicants came from 11 EU Member States and Ukraine.

The call, which covers missiles, ammunition and bombs, aims to increase the capacity of Member States and Ukraine to produce key defence products and their subcomponents. Priority areas include air defence missiles and ammunition, including counter-UxS systems, deep strike capabilities, rockets, bombs and loitering munitions.

Cooperation with Ukrainian industry was strong: 59% of the proposals were submitted by EU-Ukrainian consortia. The call offers €184.5 million in EU funding, with up to €30 million per project and coverage of 100% of eligible costs.

The Commission will now evaluate the proposals and plans to publish results in March 2027. EDIP is a €1.5 billion programme to strengthen Europe's defence industry, and its Ukraine Support Instrument has a dedicated budget of €300 million for the recovery, reconstruction and modernisation of Ukraine's defence technological and industrial base.
why: The share of joint EU-Ukrainian bids shows that partnering with Ukrainian manufacturers has become a practical route into EU defence-industrial funding, not just a political goal. With full coverage of eligible costs and large project sizes, these calls suit companies that can expand production capacity quickly. Firms in the defence supply chain that missed this round should track the next EDIP and Ukraine Support Instrument calls and start building cross-border partnerships well before the call opens.
source_name: European Commission – Defence Industry and Space
